o: Lidé by si třeba mysleli - Ono to nedělá slušný dojem, tyhlety záhadné psychologické úkazy.”
t: People might think — It doesn't make a good impression, these mysterious psychological phenomena.”

o: Za chvíli pak už pan ministr hlaholně telefonoval ministrovi vnitra: “Haló, pane kolego, tak ten ztracený dopis - Ale kdepak, nejste na stopě; já už jej mám v rukou!…
t: A moment later the minister was already cheerfully telephoning the minister of the interior: “Hello, colleague, so about that lost letter — But where on earth, you're not on the trail; I already have it in my hands!…

o: Cože, jak se našel?
t: What, how was it found?

o: Pane kolego, to vám neřeknu.
t: Colleague, I won't tell you that.

o: Víte, jsou metody, které vy v ministerstvu vnitra ještě neznáte.
t: You know, there are methods that you in the Ministry of the Interior don't know yet.

o: - Ale já vím, vaši lidé dělali, co dovedou; za to oni nemohou, že nejsou na výši…
t: — But I know your men did all they could; they can't be blamed for not being up to it…

o: Ne, nebudeme raději o tom mluvit.
t: No, we'd better not talk about it.

o: - Prosím, prosím…
t: — Please, please…

o: Servus, pane kolego!”
t: Goodbye, colleague!”
